answer: A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The nadir counter is kept in harbor and nebula publishes each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 170 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
